page.notes: Scan is heavily damaged: the right-hand column is cut off at the edge, and the upper-left corner shows a dark finger-like smear and pale background. Lines in the right-hand column and the cut-off entries (marked with ellipses) could not be read reliably and are only approximate. Left-margin catchword-like marks ("domes", "bus in", "Nuntii A", "Obje", "Obj") are scan artefacts or fragments of the printed page edge and were not transcribed as text.
